key.c: a race's candidates, favourite first: [name as filed, choice key, party as the ballot list prints it, chance, median share, 80% low, 80% high, 95% low, 95% high]. A chance is of winning, or of a seat where several are elected, and is never 0 or 1; shares are of the race's votes
key.ch: the chambers after November 3, as forecast: n seats, maj the majority line, med/lo/hi each side's seats (D, R, others: the middle and the 80 percent range of the simulated elections), ctl the shares of control (settled for D, for R, depends on the seats with no forecast, neither), g the seats with no forecast and why
key.ev: the ballots already in, as forecast: in (the ballots in the block so far, as the state's own file counts them), at (that file's time), blk (pre: cast before Election Day; mail: mail ballots), f (the block's share of all ballots taken), r: [race, the Democrat, the Republican, the block's lean, the rest's, all ballots' (each the Democrat's share of the votes for the two, whole percents, [low, middle, high] of an 80 percent range), what the first figures will likely show (B the block, R the rest, empty either way), the run]
key.mg: the likely margin of the first candidate over the second: [median, 80% low, 80% high, 95% low, 95% high]
key.r: every race the model looked at, by race id. s: f forecast, u one name for each seat (no forecast is made), n left out of the model (y: its reason). o: the office (S U.S. Senate, H U.S. House, G governor, X other statewide, L legislature, J judges, K county, M cities, towns and districts); t: title; w: place; u: the run (an index into runs); n: seats when more than one; eq: nothing on the record separates the candidates
key.ro: where the law asks for more than half the votes: the chance that no candidate passes half
key.runs: [run id, state, kind, method version, the moment the run stands for]
key.same: the first day of a stretch on which nothing in the snapshot changed
